blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata or audit notes identify direct seizure, freeze, blacklist, privileged burn, proxy-upgrade, or chain-governance intervention authority despite decentralized governance labeling.

oracleRisk.summary: RIF on Chain uses a replaceable RIF/USD PriceProvider and published Medianizer for one global RIF reserve bucket; no stronger failover tier is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDRIF is minted and redeemed against the single C0 RIF reserve bucket, whose global coverage and system states use one RIF/USD price path. The protocol has no borrower-specific collateral positions or market-specific oracle and liquidation branches; below its final coverage threshold it enters one irreversible system-wide liquidation state.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDRIF is native to Rootstock (contract 0x3a15461d..., a RIF/DOC-collateralized CDP token with no cross-chain code). Its cross-chain supply path is a LayerZero OFT route: Rootstock adapter 0xb2ee5502... locks native USDRIF and the verified Arbitrum MyOFT 0x8eef5ed... mints a destination representation; reverse transfer burns the OFT and releases the lockbox balance. At Arbitrum block 495273150 on 2026-08-16, OFT supply was 39,908.153457 USDRIF and the Rootstock adapter held exactly 39,908.153457 native USDRIF, with endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and the Rootstock peer configured. Rootstock adapter owner 0xc61820bfb8f87391d62cd3976ddc1d35e0cf7128 and Arbitrum OFT owner/delegate Safe 0xb2395eaaeb03fb1f46647c423378b24f2e906305 are explicit bridge failure domains; native Rootstock issuance remains Mint Authority.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos bridge-route re-verification; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-5 (lead usd1-world-liberty-financial); Codex mint/bridge boundary migration

protocols.name: LayerZero OFT (Arbitrum MyOFT contract)
protocols.note: Verified Arbitrum contract named MyOFT, inherits LayerZero OFT standard, uses ILayerZeroEndpointV2 with lzSend/lzReceive. Mint/burn OFT representation on the destination chain.

protocols.name: Rootstock LayerZero/Stargate OFT Adapter integration
protocols.note: Rootstock joined LayerZero (Mar 2025); native Rootstock assets go multichain via the OFT (Adapter/Lockbox) standard with Stargate as the first dApp. Home chain locks, destination mints.

routes.protocol: LayerZero OFT (via Rootstock OFT adapter lockbox)
routes.reviewNote: On-chain 2026-08-16 at Arbitrum block 495273150: this USDRIF deployment is a LayerZero OFT (endpoint() = 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, owner/delegate = Arbitrum Safe 0xb2395eaaeb03fb1f46647c423378b24f2e906305) with Rootstock EID 30333 peer set to adapter 0xb2ee550266533dc9c989e43bfe7aab6203ee2c7b. The Rootstock adapter's token() is native USDRIF and approvalRequired() is true; adapter-held native supply and Arbitrum OFT totalSupply both equal 39,908.153457 at review. LayerZero message-path mint/burn is bridge capability, while adapter-owner and OFT-owner controls are explicit Bridge Risk controls.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Rootstock adapter token() returned canonical USDRIF and approvalRequired() returned true; the adapter lockbox and Arbitrum OFT supply each measured 39,908.153457 USDRIF at the 2026-08-16 review.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The lock-mint route is supply-conserving when LayerZero messaging and the adapter accounting operate correctly: destination OFT mint follows source lock, and reverse transfer burns the OFT before source release.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The OFT itself mints and burns only on the verified LayerZero message path. Its owner/delegate Safe and the Rootstock adapter owner are separate bridge-admin controls; neither is a native Rootstock minter.
